title: Greek Constitution of 1844
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Greek Constitution of 1844", at revision 1365298668, opens: "The first constitution of the Kingdom of Greece was the Greek Constitution of 1844. On 3 September 1843, the military garrison of Athens, with the help of citizens, rebelled and demanded from King Otto the concession of a Constitution." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q5601763, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "first constitution of the Kingdom of Greece". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
